what: Timeline graphic below the Q2(A) instruction: a horizontal tick-marked arrow labelled with four decade bands (1961 to 1970, 1971 to 1980, 1981 to 1990, 1991 to 2000) and two pre-filled anchor boxes hanging off it — a 1961 box reading 'India's first successful Rocket launch' at the left end and a 2000 box reading 'Restructuring of the Department of Telecommunications' at the right end. The two middle bands are left blank for the student to fill in.
